titre.en: topics to research when u're bored pt.2

legendes.en:
as promised, pt.2.

this time it's the stuff that breaks ur brain a little: lost cities, paradoxes nobody has fully solved, physics that sounds fake, and books everyone quotes but nobody has read.

u don't need to understand all of it tonight. pick one, read about it for 20 minutes, and see where it takes u.

save this so u have something better to do than scroll.

#whattolearnwhenbored #selfimprovement #learning #curiosity #studytok

notes: Preuve : « topic to research when u're bored pt.2 » de @raretheory_ (652,5 k vues, 104 k enregistrements, 14/11), sa partie 1 (151,1 k, 11/11) ; suite de rt-001 (sa fin annonçait la pt.2). Même gabarit et même musique (original sound - starxedittt). Catégories neuves, aucune reprise de rt-001 ni des siennes : Ancient Worlds, Famous Paradoxes, Physics That Breaks Your Brain, Numbers & Math Mysteries, Books Everyone References, Strange Places on Earth ; sujets réels, vérifiés, aucun sujet violent, médical ou politique. Slide Sophia (5, « 04 — the 10-minute lesson ») : son LOGO à la place de la petite photo, jamais une capture ; cta B. en.sous_titre: one rabbit hole at a time

paragraphes: before i go down a rabbit hole, i do the 10-minute lesson on Sophia. one short lesson a day: history, philosophy, science, geopolitics, literature, economics.
it's written by actual professors and there's a little quiz after, so i actually remember it. then i pick one topic from this list and keep going.

en.texte: save this for the next time u're bored. pick one topic, give it 20 minutes, and see how far the rabbit hole goes.
en.gras: OR.. u'll be bored again tomorrow.
